filing.title: Harbor Foods Group SC 13E3 going-private transaction statement
filing.bodyText:
SC 13E-3
Issuer: Harbor Foods Group Inc.
This Schedule 13E-3 transaction statement relates to a Rule 13e-3 going private transaction. Harbor Parent Holdings LLC will acquire all shares of Harbor Foods Group Inc. held by unaffiliated stockholders for $11.25 per share in cash. The special committee determined that the transaction is fair to unaffiliated stockholders. Completion is subject to approval by a majority of unaffiliated shares and other customary conditions. Stockholders who do not tender may have appraisal rights under Delaware law.
